Grain & Purpose: Aircraft model (737-700, 737-800, 737 MAX 8), ICAO/IATA codes, interior generation, total/tier seat counts, pitch bands, max seat width, power, Wi-Fi, and lavatory layout.
Row-level geometry, including explicit row_exists = false records for skipped rows 10–13 on 73G, omitted seat letters (1A–1C, 14A, 15A/15F, 30A/30F), exit/bulkhead flags, and FAA recline locks.

Atomic physical seat attributes: seat_code, seat_position_type (Window/Middle/Aisle), commercial_tier (Extra Legroom/Preferred/Standard), pitch_range_inches, effective_width_inches, recline_status, window_status (Standard/Missing/Limited/Obstructed/Misaligned/Set-Back/N/A), has_unobstructed_legroom, tray_table_location, underseat_storage_allowed, and power_type.
